title: Playing with Fats Domino
summary: In 1988 he played with Fats Domino and learned to play familiar material as though for the first time.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Let’s return to your performing career. According to the record – it says you worked with Fats Domino?

In ’88. I was still at Berklee when I played with Fats. It was great. He generally didn’t use trombone. Again, learned a lot from him and Ray about playing the same material, but as though it’s the first time.
